Name: JP's Bag Of Tools
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#00ff00]﻿[u][center]Bag Of Tools[/center][/u][/color][/i][/b][/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Here are some tools I created to speed up certain processes and make small GIFs. Maybe one of them will come in handy for you![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4]This mod makes a few small changes to various aspects of the game to avoid the tedium of repeatedly testing new games and to create lightweight GIFs.[/size]
[b][color=#00ffff][size=5][u]Content:[/u][/size][/color][/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3RxpZXp1/Camarawe1.gif[/img]
﻿[b][size=3]The leveling menus will no longer appear, and professions are selected automatically (configurable). This is useful if you're leveling up all the way for testing or similar purposes, as you won't have to go through each menu with unlocked recipes and professions to choose from. [/size][/b]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MT3B3nb3/Camarawe1_1.gif[/img]
[b][size=3]You can pause and/or remove the water animation; since it can use up a lot of resources when creating GIFs, this is quite convenient. If you remove it, you can see the background, which is kind of funny but hard on the eyes, haha.[/size][size=4] [/size][/b]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hjtx0Lxh/Camarawe1_2.gif[/img]
[b][size=3]You can pause the map animations, from waterfalls to those dancing flowers. They’re minor animations, but they can be helpful in certain situations. [/size][/b]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zBGWkCWq/Camarawe1_3.gif[/img]
[size=3][b]The window that counts the items in the shipping bin has been removed. On the new day, a message in the HUD will show you the final value of the products sold. [/b][/size]


[/font][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/63bZb8Ld/Camarawe1_4.gif[/img][/font][font=Georgia]
[b][size=3]The steam from the spa has been removed. It's just a minor detail. [/size][/b]


[/font][font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/qRDKDNxV/Camarawe1_5.gif[/img][/font][font=Georgia]
[b][size=3]Removed raindrops and leaves/snow. [/size][/b]


[b][size=3]The tutorials on the controls have been removed. [/size][/b]


[/font][font=Georgia][size=5][b][i]That's it. Everything can be customized using GMCM—they're simple tools. [color=#00ff00]If you have any suggestions about something in the game that bothers you, feel free to share them; maybe we can fix it.[/color] [/i][/b][/size]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
